summary: Both new features fully verified on Kranti Ganesh Mandal 2026 (Expo/RN + FastAPI + MongoDB). BACKEND (2/2 PASS): GET /api/dashboard returns my_vargani = {full_name, target_amount:5000, collected:1000, pending:4000} for member 9998887770, and null for super_admin. Full regression suite (42/42) passes serially. FRONTEND (all 4 scenarios PASS at 390x844 mobile viewport): (1) Member login shows payment-reminder-banner reading 'Your Vargani is pending ₹4,000 left of ₹5,000 target'; tapping navigates to /vargani. (2) Add Event: tapping event-date-input opens calendar modal with correct month title 'August 2026', calendar-prev/next navigation works (Aug->Oct->Sep), calendar-today button closes modal and fills field with '30 Aug 2026'. Selecting day 25 in December 2026 sets field to '25 Dec 2026'; event was created via API with event_date='2026-12-25'. (3) Edit Event: opening an existing event correctly prefills date field as '25 Dec 2026' and calendar opens on 'December 2026'; picking day 10 updates field to '10 Dec 2026' and saves as event_date='2026-12-10'. (4) All expected testIDs present (payment-reminder-banner, event-date-input, calendar-month, calendar-prev, calendar-next, calendar-day-N, calendar-today). TEST event created was deleted at the end. Non-blocking console warnings persist (shadow*, pointerEvents deprecations, font decode) — unrelated cosmetic issues. Deprecated packages/RN issues detected: none.

issues: Non-blocking: existing web console warnings (shadow* deprecated, pointerEvents deprecated, SpaceGrotesk/PlusJakartaSans .ttf font-decode) still present; cosmetic only, unrelated to these features.

action_items: Optional (test infra, not a product bug): the legacy /app/backend/tests/test_kranti_mandal.py stores auth tokens on a module-level `state` dict and is not safe under pytest-xdist parallel workers. `pytest backend/tests/` (which the default addopts run with -n auto --dist loadscope) shows 35 failures purely due to state not shared across workers; the same file passes 34/34 with -o addopts=''. Consider migrating to shared pytest fixtures/conftest or scope-per-file to keep xdist compatible.
critical_code_review_comments: DatePickerField.tsx is well-scoped and pure-RN (no native module dependency) — safe for web preview. Uses parseDateLocal/formatEventDate helpers correctly, avoiding UTC-midnight off-by-one.

add-event.tsx still contains the now-unused DATE_RE regex validation on submit (`if (!DATE_RE.test(date))`) — since date is guaranteed YYYY-MM-DD from the picker, this is fine as a safety net but could be simplified to `if (!date)`.
server.py /api/dashboard: my_vargani is computed via find_one on members.profile_id and enrich_member — correct approach; returns null cleanly for admins/super_admins who have no linked member row.

Payment reminder banner in (tabs)/index.tsx correctly guards with `!isAdmin && d!.my_vargani && d!.my_vargani.target_amount > 0` and shows the 'fully paid' variant when pending===0. testIDs (payment-reminder-banner, payment-reminder-done) are in place.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_CalendarEvt (2026-12-25 -> edited to 2026-12-10) via UI; deleted at end. No lingering test data. Seeded member 9998887770 and superadmin were untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both features (calendar DatePickerField + member payment-reminder-banner) are stable. Effective server 'today' is ~30 Aug 2026 so events dated before this won't appear under dashboard.upcoming_events. To exercise the fully-paid variant (payment-reminder-done card), fully collect member 9998887770's pending 4000 via /api/payments then reload dashboard as that member. Legacy backend test file test_kranti_mandal.py needs conftest/fixture migration to run under xdist.
